Aye mere chaadar lapetne waale
Raat ko utho magar zara kam
Aadhi raat ya is se bhi kuchh kam kar do
Ya kuchh zyaada kar do, aur Qur'an ko theher theher kar baa-qaaida padho
Hum anqareeb tumhaare oopar ek sangeen hukm naazil karne waale hain
Be-shak raat ka uthna nafs ki paamaali ke liye behtareen zariya aur zikr ka behtareen waqt hai
Yaqeenan aap ke liye din mein bahut si mashghooliyaat hain
Aur aap apne Rabb ke naam ka zikr karein aur usi ke ho rahein
Woh mashriq o maghrib ka maalik hai aur us ke ilaawa koi Khuda nahin hai, lehaaza aap usi ko apna nigraan bana lein
Aur ye log jo kuchh bhi keh rahe hain us par sabr karein aur inhein khoobsoorti ke saath apne se alag kar dein
Aur humein aur in daulatmand jhutlaane waalon ko chhod dein aur inhein thodi mohlat de dein
Hamaare paas in ke liye bediyaan aur bhadakti hui aag hai
Aur gale mein phans jaane waala khaana aur dardnaak azaab hai
Jis din zameen aur pahaad larze mein aa jaayenge aur pahaad ret ka ek teela ban jaayenge
Be-shak hum ne tum logon ki taraf tumhaara gawaah bana kar ek Rasool bheja hai jis tarah Fir'aun ki taraf Rasool bheja tha
To Fir'aun ne us Rasool ki naafarmaani ki to hum ne use sakht giraft mein le liya
Phir tum bhi kufr ikhtiyaar karoge to us din se kis tarah bachoge jo bachchon ko boodha bana dega
Jis din aasmaan phat padega aur ye waada bahar-haal poora hone waala hai
Ye dar-haqeeqat ibrat o naseehat ki baatein hain, aur jis ka jee chaahe apne Parwardigar ke raaste ko ikhtiyaar kar le

Aap ka Parwardigar jaanta hai ke do tihaai raat ke qareeb ya nisf shab ya ek tihaai raat qiyaam karte hain, aur aap ke saath ek giroh aur bhi hai, aur Allah din o raat ka saheeh andaaza rakhta hai. Woh jaanta hai ke tum log is ka saheeh ihsa na kar sakoge, to us ne tumhaare oopar mehrbaani kar di hai. Ab jis qadr Qur'an mumkin ho utna padh lo, ke woh jaanta hai ke anqareeb tum mein se baaz mareez ho jaayenge aur baaz rizq-e-Khuda ko talaash karne ke liye safar mein chale jaayenge aur baaz raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karenge. To jis qadr mumkin ho tilaawat karo aur namaaz qaaim karo aur zakaat ada karo aur Allah ko qarz-e-hasana do, aur phir jo kuchh bhi apne nafs ke waaste neki peshgi bhej doge use Khuda ki baargaah mein haazir paaoge, behtar aur ajr ke etibaar se azeem-tar. Aur Allah se istighfaar karo ke woh bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur mehrbaan hai
